## Niagen Bioscience to Present at the Sixth Annual Longevity Summit Taking Place at the Buck Institute for Research on Aging


November 16, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/770776702/files/doc_news/Niagen-Bioscience-to-Present-at-the-Sixth-Annual-Longevity-Summit-Taking-Place-at-the-Buck-Institute-for-Research-on-Aging-2026.pdf)


*Dr. Abhijit Kale to outline the next phase of the Niagen Research Program*


LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Niagen Bioscience, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com%2F&esheet=54641461&newsitemid=20261116134495&lan=en-US&anchor=Niagen+Bioscience%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=779ef1ce658095e2956f090cb49d2da5) (NASDAQ: NAGE), the global authority on NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) with a focus on the science of healthy aging, today announced it will support the[Sixth Annual Longevity Summit](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Flongevitygl.org%2Flongevity-summit-2026%2F&esheet=54641461&newsitemid=20261116134495&lan=en-US&anchor=Sixth+Annual+Longevity+Summit&index=2&md5=e1aec3ba29938e9af1d68f9f2feb4c20) taking place from December 9 to 10, 2026, at the Buck Institute for Research on Aging in Novato, California. **** The Summit, themed “The Future of Medicine: Eliminating Diseases of Aging,” convenes researchers, investors and government organizations to discuss translating longevity research into medicines.


Abhijit Kale, Ph.D., Senior Director of Global External Research at Niagen Bioscience, will present “Shaping the Future of NAD+ Research: From Niagen® Science to Healthy Aging.” He will discuss how Niagen®, the Company’s flagship patented nicotinamide riboside (NR) ingredient, and its[Niagen Research Program](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com%2Fpages%2Fniagenresearchprogram&esheet=54641461&newsitemid=20261116134495&lan=en-US&anchor=Niagen+Research+Program&index=3&md5=0b0685be85e5c79c1e2bfd18fa7b8b1b) have advanced the science of NAD+ through scientific collaborations with world-renowned institutions, including Stanford University, Johns Hopkins, Mayo Clinic, Harvard University, MIT, and the National Institutes of Health (NIH).


The Niagen Research Program has established a broad research foundation, with more than 320 research agreements across 30+ countries and more than 240 peer-reviewed publications, including over 50 peer-reviewed clinical studies on Niagen, more than 92% of them independent. Dr. Kale will outline the Niagen Research Program’s next chapter: strategically designed research that translates NAD+ biology to meaningful insights on healthy aging, healthspan (years lived in good health), and clinically relevant outcomes.


The shift is already underway, highlighted by a[Start-Up Agreement](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.niagenbioscience.com%2Fnews%2Fnews-details%2F2026%2FNiagen-Bioscience-Announces-Start-Up-Agreement-With-Mass-General-Brigham-MGB-Investigators-For-First-Of-Its-Kind-Healthy-Aging-Clinical-Trial%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54641461&newsitemid=20261116134495&lan=en-US&anchor=Start-Up+Agreement&index=4&md5=ad28211206b99da20f4a2ad8796c74f1) with Mass General Brigham (MGB) announced this September. This first-of-its-kind prevention trial lays the groundwork for a proposed multi-year, randomized, placebo-controlled study of Niagen in apparently healthy adults aged 50 and older. Developed by MGB investigator Howard Sesso, ScD, MPH, Associate Director, Division of Preventive Medicine, Brigham and Women’s Hospital and Associate Professor of Medicine, Harvard Medical School, in collaboration with the Niagen Research Program, the study will assess major clinical outcomes, functional measures of intrinsic capacity and biomarkers of biological aging and healthy-aging measures, and related biomarkers. This prevention initiative represents an important beginning in Niagen’s healthy-aging journey, moving science toward understanding whether sustained NAD+ augmentation can translate into meaningful health outcomes as people age. Design details remain subject to final agreements. Dr. Kale will discuss expanding this approach through targeted global collaborations and biomarker-driven studies using oral food-grade and pharmaceutical-grade intravenous and injectable Niagen.


Beyond prevention, findings from the Niagen Research Program have also informed the Company’s work in rare diseases in which NAD+ dependent processes, including DNA repair and mitochondrial function, are impaired. NB4168 is the first investigational therapeutic candidate to emerge from Niagen Bioscience’s[recently announced](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.niagenbioscience.com%2Fnews%2Fnews-details%2F2026%2FNiagen-Bioscience-Launches-Pharmaceutical-Program-for-Accelerated-Aging-and-Rare-Genetic-Diseases%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54641461&newsitemid=20261116134495&lan=en-US&anchor=recently+announced&index=5&md5=41557a4fd4de9ddcacfd3d69d7d84753) wholly owned subsidiary focused on developing therapies for rare genetic diseases and age-related disorders,[NAD Pharmaceuticals Corp](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com%2Fpages%2Fnad-pharmaceuticals&esheet=54641461&newsitemid=20261116134495&lan=en-US&anchor=NAD+Pharmaceuticals+Corp&index=6&md5=c0e1968edd50483ab16198d930d5455c) . An oral small molecule designed to deliver significantly increased doses of NR to the bloodstream, NB4168 is being developed first for Ataxia-Telangiectasia (A-T), a rare genetic disease caused by ATM gene mutations with features of accelerated aging. It is investigational and not approved for any use.


For additional information on the Niagen External Research Program, visit[www.niagenbioscience.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com%2Fpages%2Fniagenresearchprogram&esheet=54641461&newsitemid=20261116134495&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenbioscience.com&index=7&md5=5bbdf4e8c6071c094b41a80429ec3f9c) .


**About Niagen Bioscience**


[Niagen Bioscience, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com%2F&esheet=54641461&newsitemid=20261116134495&lan=en-US&anchor=Niagen+Bioscience%2C+Inc.&index=8&md5=dca158db2242c8b0eba139d678749d51) (NASDAQ: NAGE) is the global authority in healthy aging and NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) science. As a trusted pioneer of NAD+ discoveries, Niagen Bioscience **™** is dedicated to advancing healthspan through precision science and innovative NAD+-boosting solutions.


The Niagen Bioscience team, composed of world-renowned scientists, works with independent investigators from esteemed universities and research institutions around the globe to uncover the full potential of NAD+. A vital coenzyme found in every cell of the human body, NAD+ declines with age and exposure to everyday lifestyle stressors. NAD+ depletion is a key contributor to age-related changes in health and vitality.


Distinguished by state-of-the-art laboratories, rigorous scientific and quality protocols, and collaborations with leading research institutions worldwide, Niagen Bioscience sets the gold standard for research, quality, and innovation. There’s a better way to age.


At the heart of its clinically tested product portfolio is Niagen® (patented nicotinamide riboside, or NR), the most efficient, well-researched, and high-quality NAD+ booster available. Niagen powers the Company’s consumer supplement, Tru Niagen®, the number one NAD+ boosting oral supplement in the United States† (available at[www.truniagen.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.truniagen.com&esheet=54641461&newsitemid=20261116134495&lan=en-US&anchor=www.truniagen.com&index=9&md5=ab7967517e7b669ef2f1459567bd19d6) ), and Niagen™ Plus, featuring pharmaceutical-grade intravenous (IV) and injectable Niagen products ([www.niagenplus.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenplus.com&esheet=54641461&newsitemid=20261116134495&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenplus.com&index=10&md5=75e7efe6828d3c28f93c018d701c7756) ). Pharmaceutical-grade Niagen IV and injections are compounded and distributed by U.S. FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facilities and are available exclusively at clinics with a prescription. NAD Pharmaceuticals Corp., the Company’s wholly owned subsidiary focused on developing therapies for accelerated aging and rare genetic diseases, is conducting research on NB4168, a differentiated small molecule.


Niagen Bioscience’s robust patent portfolio protects NR and other NAD+ precursors. Niagen Bioscience maintains a website at[www.niagenbioscience.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com&esheet=54641461&newsitemid=20261116134495&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenbioscience.com&index=11&md5=e6908dee17ec477e1e37d58a734a17fe) , where copies of press releases, news, and financial information are regularly published.
